content: Make W0112 asynchronous backend completion generation-bound by retaining the exact backend binding and lease callbacks with the pending request, so backend replacement cannot release or query through the new binding; add a regression covering replacement during an in-flight event.

Implemented generation-bound pending backend binding snapshots in 3140df7, documented the boundary in d7de5a0, and verified the focused cdev/client/component tests 3/3 plus full development CTest 84/84; git diff --check passed.
